Potential alternatives or changes: Samsung, Intel Foundry and development of Chinese foundry capabilities
Status and distinction: Samsung and Intel are established manufacturers. Process availability and external-customer maturity differ; Chinese development is not assumed to match the frontier.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Competitive yield, sustained volume, design support and independently identifiable customer adoption
Notes: A process announcement or internal product launch alone does not establish a substitutable external foundry service.

Established concentration or model: ASML in commercial extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography
Potential alternatives or changes: Alternative patterning, including Canon nanoimprint, and domestic lithography research
Status and distinction: Nanoimprint equipment has been delivered, but that does not establish a general replacement for EUV in leading-edge logic.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Production throughput, overlay accuracy, defect control, reliability and economically viable yield
Notes: Research announcements, including Chinese efforts, are not evidence of a qualified commercial EUV substitute.

Potential alternatives or changes: AMD accelerators, Google TPUs, AWS Trainium, Huawei Ascend and custom chips
Status and distinction: Commercial alternatives exist; workloads, software and procurement channels differ.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Comparable task quality, sustained throughput, total cost, software support and deployment at scale
Notes: Application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) may substitute for selected workloads without replacing general-purpose GPU use.

Established concentration or model: South Korean suppliers in high-bandwidth memory (HBM)
Potential alternatives or changes: Micron expansion, new HBM generations and alternative memory designs
Status and distinction: Micron is an established HBM supplier, not a new entrant. Alternative memory designs may serve different workload needs.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Qualified volume, yields, customer adoption and competitive system performance
Notes: Supplier headquarters and the location of memory fabrication or packaging are distinct.

Potential alternatives or changes: Intel, Samsung and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers
Status and distinction: Alternative packaging platforms exist, with different integration approaches and qualifications.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: High-volume production, competitive yield, thermal performance and customer qualification
Notes: Expansion in conventional packaging does not by itself replace advanced AI integration capacity.

Potential alternatives or changes: National compute programs, specialist clouds and locally governed AI infrastructure
Status and distinction: New capacity and local operating control can diversify providers while retaining foreign chip, software or financing dependencies.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Delivered compute, sustainable utilization, competitive costs and control over data, operations and supplier relationships
Notes: Local hosting does not by itself establish operational or technological independence.

Potential alternatives or changes: Open-weight models, distillation and smaller specialized models
Status and distinction: Deployed alternatives exist; capability and economics vary by task and quality requirement.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Comparable task results at lower full deployment cost, including adaptation, evaluation and operation
Notes: Open-weight describes access to model weights; it does not necessarily mean unrestricted licensing or complete training transparency.

Potential alternatives or changes: On-device and edge inference, sometimes combined with cloud services
Status and distinction: On-device deployment is established for some tasks; hardware, memory and model limits remain.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Acceptable quality, latency, privacy, energy use and total deployment cost
Notes: Moving inference to devices does not eliminate centralized model training or every cloud dependency.

Potential alternatives or changes: New suppliers, regional investment and qualification of alternative materials
Status and distinction: New capacity becomes substitutable only after meeting the relevant manufacturing requirements.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Consistent purity and uniformity, sustained qualified output and customer acceptance
Notes: A materials plant announcement is not equivalent to a qualified semiconductor-grade supply source.

Established concentration or model: Conventional grid supply for data centers
Potential alternatives or changes: Dedicated generation, nuclear projects, grid modernization and more efficient cooling
Status and distinction: Options vary from operating assets to proposals with long development and permitting schedules.
Evidence of meaningful substitution: Delivered electricity, reliable operation, viable costs and actual usable compute capacity
Notes: Cooling reduces energy demand; it is not a source of electricity. Nuclear announcements are not operating generation.
